notes.title: First trailer of Frosty Enterprise is released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297439/906468d03fb4b04c7e32b1d029c2d3bfbf9dddc8.png[/img]

[h1]Hello gamers![/h1]

First trailer of Frosty Enterprise is finally released! Take a look to see first gameplay footage from the game!

The trailer shows general gameplay mechanics, the game's map, resources and different products that you can create in your ice cream truck!
